北京邮电大学牛凯—张平团队语义通信论文调研

面向具有深度学习基础、通信基础较少的读者。检索范围为 2021-01-01 至 2026-07-15；核心表仅保留正式同行评审技术研究论文，会议版若有期刊扩展版则只保留期刊版。

核心论文 112资源分配与跨层优化 41物理层调制、波形与 MIMO 35多用户接入与广播 12语义信源编码与系统设计 8联合信源信道编码（JSCC） 7通信安全与隐私 6任务导向边缘推理 3

先看懂一篇通信论文处在哪

原始数据/任务
语义/信源编码
信道编码
调制、MIMO、OFDM
无线信道
译码/重建/任务

传统系统常分别优化这些方框；语义通信论文通常合并其中若干环节。评价一篇论文时要问：发送的中间表示是什么？占多少信道资源？噪声在哪里加入？接收端恢复的是原始数据还是任务结果？

常见带宽比可写为 $ ho=n/k$，其中 $k$ 是源样本维度，$n$ 是信道使用次数。只有在相同 $ ho$、发射功率和信道模型下，方法间性能比较才公平。

推荐阅读顺序

  1. Nonlinear Transform Source-Channel Coding for Semantic Communications
    文本传输/机器翻译 · 数字调制或混合数字-模拟链路
  2. Semantic Communication System Based on Semantic Slice Models Propagation
    语音/音频传输或识别 · 显式离散/数字语义表示
  3. Wireless Deep Video Semantic Transmission
    视频传输/生成 · 数字调制或混合数字-模拟链路
  4. Rethinking Generative Semantic Communication for Multi-User Systems with Large Language Models
    语音/音频传输或识别 · 显式离散/数字语义表示

顺序按“早期基础 → 显式数字化 → 信道/多用户系统 → 最新生成式或跨层工作”组织；引用数只用于帮助挑入口，不代表论文质量排序。

通信小白术语表

信源编码去掉源数据中的冗余，目标是用更少 bit/符号表示内容。
信道编码加入受控冗余，让接收端能够发现或纠正无线传输产生的错误。
JSCC联合信源信道编码；把压缩和抗噪声传输一起设计。
SNR信噪比；越低表示噪声相对越强。比较方法时必须保证 SNR 定义和功率约束一致。
带宽比/CBR信道使用次数相对源维度或像素数的比例，是通信开销而不是模型参数量。
CSI信道状态信息；发射端/接收端是否知道它，会显著改变问题难度。
cliff effect传统分离链路在低于解码门限后性能突然崩溃；模拟式 DeepJSCC 常呈渐进退化。
语义指标以任务正确率、BLEU、CLIP 相似度等衡量意义是否保留，但不自动等价于可靠通信。

方法与通信系统定位

研究任务：语音/音频传输或识别

所属环节：任务导向边缘推理。接收端不必恢复原始数据，只需完成分类、检索或推理任务；核心指标从像素误差转向任务正确率。

给深度学习研究生的解释：它类似 split learning：设备只上传足以完成下游任务的中间特征，通信系统关心的是任务准确率和时延，而不是把原数据无损搬过去。

主要实验结论（带全文页码）

  • Compared with existing semantic systems, DKSC is a dual-path framework which not only considers the seman- tic extraction and reconstruction at image level, but also at concept level. • Based on neural networks, the semantic encoder and decoder, together with the channel layer, are jointly designed to optimize the DKSC system in an end-to-end manner. PDF p.2
  • With the integration of domain knowledge, DKSC can recover the image accurately with clear regions of interest. • The performance of the proposed DKSC is veriﬁed by extensive experiments and the results conﬁrm that DKSC is robust to different channel environments and capable to achieve better performance in terms of image restoration metrics than other baseline communication systems. PDF p.2
  • In the region of low SNR, JPEG breaks down and the decoder can not achieve a meaningful reconstruction, resulting in abrupt quality degradation. PDF p.4
  • This DKSC- variant slightly outperforms JSCC however underperforms the original DKSC signiﬁcantly in terms of LPIPS results. PDF p.5

方法与通信系统定位

研究任务：文本传输/机器翻译

所属环节：通信安全与隐私。研究语义特征在无线窃听、模型反演或攻击下是否泄露，以及可靠性和隐私之间的权衡。

给深度学习研究生的解释：即使传的不是原始比特，latent 仍可能泄露内容；安全研究要同时检查合法接收端性能和窃听者能恢复多少信息。

为什么方法可能解决开头的问题：方案把论文关注的语义表示、信道或资源约束放进同一训练/优化目标，使发送端学习的不只是数据压缩，而是“在给定无线资源和噪声下什么信息最值得发送”。

主要实验结论（带全文页码）

  • Since the accuracy and efficiency of SR vary with the gran- ularity of Sebs, by considering the specific requirements of the communication intent, a balance can be achieved through the comprehensive application of Sebs with different granularities. PDF p.5
  • To ensure the system can achieve both intelligence and high efficiency, a semantic intelligence (SI) plane integrating the KB is introduced, where Sebs and their corresponding importance information (as discussed in Section 2) are in- corporated into the KB. PDF p.6
  • To achieve UEP for semantic flows according to their level of importance, the interaction between the SI plane and the physical layer is taken into consideration. PDF p.7
  • Consequently, the proposed method achieves superior perceptual quality compared with the BPG, JSCC, and VQSemCom methods. PDF p.8
  • It can be observed that, when the SNR reaches 4 dB and above, all schemes achieve error-free trans- mission. PDF p.9

  • In this article, based on orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) communication architecture, the semantic importance-aware reordering-enhanced SemCom system (SIARE-SC) is proposed, which utilizes the inequality of semantic symbols combined with channel estimation in OFDM systems to reduce the distortion caused by channel estimation interpolation error (CEIE) and further improve the signal recovery quality. PDF p.1
  • Joint source channel coding (JSCC) [6] is the main technique used in the design of many SemCom systems, which employs an autoencoder model as an end-to-end codec to learn to extract the semantic information of the input message while mitigating the semantic information from channel contamination. PDF p.1
  • Jiang et al. [22] introduced an OFDM architecture into semantic video conferencing and proposes a keypoint detection network to improve the accu- racy of acceptance recovery. PDF p.2
  • The source X gets the semantic symbols S by latent transform and JSCC encoder, S gets the importance array W by the entropy model, and then rate control is performed using W to get the semantic symbols S′ to be transmitted, and then the important semantic symbols are placed near to the pilot by importance reordering, and then OFDM transmission is performed. PDF p.3

  • This paper proposes a digital gen- erative SemCom (DGSemCom) framework, which incorporates product quantization (PQ) for efﬁcient discrete feature repre- sentation and a discrete denoising diffusion model for latent error correction. PDF p.1
  • First, to achieve efﬁcient discrete semantic representation, PQ decomposes high-dimensional semantic space into independent low-dimensional subspaces, each discretized by a compact codebook. PDF p.1
  • Second, to mitigate the vulnerability of discrete semantic transmission, DGSemCom reformulates error correction as a posterior decoding process by decoupling semantic priors and channel likelihood modeling. PDF p.1
  • Speciﬁcally, a discrete denoising diffusion model is adopted to model semantic priors, and the posterior sampling process is guided by received corrupted discrete semantic representations as constraints. PDF p.1
